verses.en: A soft answer turneth away wrath: but grievous words stir up anger.
verses.pt: A resposta suave desvia o furor, mas a palavra pesada faz a ira aumentar.
verses.en_web: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
verses.en_bbe: By a soft answer wrath is turned away, but a bitter word is a cause of angry feelings.

verses.en: The tongue of the wise useth knowledge aright: but the mouth of fools poureth out foolishness.
verses.pt: A língua dos sábios faz bom uso da sabedoria, mas a boca dos tolos derrama loucura.
verses.en_web: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of fools gush out folly.
verses.en_bbe: Knowledge is dropping from the tongue of the wise; but from the mouth of the foolish comes a stream of foolish words.

verses.en: The eyes of the LORD are in every place, beholding the evil and the good.
verses.pt: Os olhos do SENHOR estão em todo lugar, observando os maus e os bons.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.
verses.en_bbe: The eyes of the Lord are in every place, keeping watch on the evil and the good.

verses.en: A wholesome tongue is a tree of life: but perverseness therein is a breach in the spirit.
verses.pt: Uma língua sã é árvore de vida; mas a perversidade nela é faz o espírito em pedaços.
verses.en_web: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.
verses.en_bbe: A comforting tongue is a tree of life, but a twisted tongue is a crushing of the spirit.

verses.en: A fool despiseth his father’s instruction: but he that regardeth reproof is prudent.
verses.pt: O tolo despreza a correção de seu pai; mas aquele que presta atenção à repreensão age com prudência.
verses.en_web: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.
verses.en_bbe: A foolish man puts no value on his father's training; but he who has respect for teaching has good sense.

verses.en: In the house of the righteous is much treasure: but in the revenues of the wicked is trouble.
verses.pt: Na casa dos justo há um grande tesouro; mas na renda do perverso há perturbação.
verses.en_web: In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.
verses.en_bbe: In the house of the upright man there is a great store of wealth; but in the profits of the sinner there is trouble.

verses.en: The lips of the wise disperse knowledge: but the heart of the foolish doeth not so.
verses.pt: Os lábios dos sábios derramam conhecimento; mas o coração dos tolos não age assim.
verses.en_web: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.
verses.en_bbe: The lips of the wise keep knowledge, but the heart of the foolish man is not right.

verses.en: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD: but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
verses.pt: O sacrifício dos perversos é abominável ao SENHOR, mas a oração dos justos é seu agrado.
verses.en_web: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.
verses.en_bbe: The offering of the evil-doer is disgusting to the Lord, but the prayer of the upright man is his delight.

verses.en: The way of the wicked is an abomination unto the LORD: but he loveth him that followeth after righteousness.
verses.pt: Abominável ao SENHOR é o caminho do perverso; porém ele ama ao que segue a justiça.
verses.en_web: The way of the wicked is an abomination to Yahweh, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: The way of the evil-doer is disgusting to the Lord, but he who goes after righteousness is dear to him.

verses.en: Correction is grievous unto him that forsaketh the way: and he that hateth reproof shall die.
verses.pt: A correção é ruim para aquele que deixa o caminho; e quem odeia a repreensão morrerá.
verses.en_web: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way: whoever hates reproof shall die.
verses.en_bbe: There is bitter punishment for him who is turned from the way; and death will be the fate of the hater of teaching.

verses.en: Hell and destruction are before the LORD: how much more then the hearts of the children of men?
verses.pt: O Xeol e a perdição estão perante o SENHOR; quanto mais os corações dos filhos dos homens!
verses.en_web: Sheol and Abaddon are before Yahweh— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!
verses.en_bbe: Before the Lord are the underworld and destruction: how much more, then, the hearts of the children of men!

verses.en: A scorner loveth not one that reproveth him: neither will he go unto the wise.
verses.pt: O zombador não ama quem o repreende, nem se aproximará dos sábios.
verses.en_web: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.
verses.en_bbe: The hater of authority has no love for teaching: he will not go to the wise.

verses.en: A merry heart maketh a cheerful countenance: but by sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.
verses.pt: O coração alegre anima o rosto, mas pela dor do coração o espírito se abate.
verses.en_web: A glad heart makes a cheerful face; but an aching heart breaks the spirit.
verses.en_bbe: A glad heart makes a shining face, but by the sorrow of the heart the spirit is broken.

verses.en: The heart of him that hath understanding seeketh knowledge: but the mouth of fools feedeth on foolishness.
verses.pt: O coração prudente buscará o conhecimento, mas a boca dos tolos se alimentará de loucura.
verses.en_web: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.
verses.en_bbe: The heart of the man of good sense goes in search of knowledge, but foolish things are the food of the unwise.

verses.en: All the days of the afflicted are evil: but he that is of a merry heart hath a continual feast.
verses.pt: Todos os dias do oprimido são maus, mas o coração alegre é como um banquete contínuo.
verses.en_web: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.
verses.en_bbe: All the days of the troubled are evil; but he whose heart is glad has an unending feast.

verses.en: Better is little with the fear of the LORD than great treasure and trouble therewith.
verses.pt: Melhor é o pouco tendo o temor ao SENHOR, do que um grande tesouro tendo em si inquietação.
verses.en_web: Better is little, with the fear of Yahweh, than great treasure with trouble.
verses.en_bbe: Better is a little with the fear of the Lord, than great wealth together with trouble.

verses.en: Better is a dinner of herbs where love is, than a stalled ox and hatred therewith.
verses.pt: Melhor é a comida de hortaliças tendo amor, do que a de boi cevado tendo em si ódio.
verses.en_web: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.
verses.en_bbe: Better is a simple meal where love is, than a fat ox and hate with it.

verses.en: A wrathful man stirreth up strife: but he that is slow to anger appeaseth strife.
verses.pt: O homem que fica irritado facilmente gera brigas; mas aquele que demora para se irar apaziguará o confronto.
verses.en_web: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.
verses.en_bbe: An angry man makes men come to blows, but he who is slow to get angry puts an end to fighting.

verses.en: The way of the slothful man is as an hedge of thorns: but the way of the righteous is made plain.
verses.pt: O caminho do preguiçoso é como uma cerca de espinhos; mas a vereda dos corretos é bem aplanada.
verses.en_web: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.
verses.en_bbe: Thorns are round the way of the hater of work; but the road of the hard worker becomes a highway.

verses.en: A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish man despiseth his mother.
verses.pt: O filho sábio alegra ao pai, mas o homem tolo despreza a sua mãe.
verses.en_web: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.
verses.en_bbe: A wise son makes a glad father, but a foolish man has no respect for his mother.

verses.en: Folly is joy to him that is destitute of wisdom: but a man of understanding walketh uprightly.
verses.pt: A loucura é alegria para aquele que tem falta de prudência; mas o homem de bom entendimento andará corretamente.
verses.en_web: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.
verses.en_bbe: Foolish behaviour is joy to the unwise; but a man of good sense makes his way straight.

verses.en: Without counsel purposes are disappointed: but in the multitude of counsellors they are established.
verses.pt: Os planos fracassam quando não há bom conselho; mas com abundância de conselheiros eles se confirmam.
verses.en_web: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.
verses.en_bbe: Where there are no wise suggestions, purposes come to nothing; but by a number of wise guides they are made certain.

verses.en: A man hath joy by the answer of his mouth: and a word spoken in due season, how good is it!
verses.pt: O homem se alegra com a resposta de sua boca; e como é boa a palavra a seu devido tempo!
verses.en_web: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!
verses.en_bbe: A man has joy in the answer of his mouth: and a word at the right time, how good it is!

verses.en: The way of life is above to the wise, that he may depart from hell beneath.
verses.pt: Para o prudente, o caminho da vida é para cima, para que se afaste do Xeol, que é para baixo.
verses.en_web: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.
verses.en_bbe: Acting wisely is the way of life, guiding a man away from the underworld.

verses.en: The LORD will destroy the house of the proud: but he will establish the border of the widow.
verses.pt: O SENHOR destruirá a casa dos arrogantes, mas confirmará os limites do terreno da viúva.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.
verses.en_bbe: The house of the man of pride will be uprooted by the Lord, but he will make safe the heritage of the widow.

verses.en: The thoughts of the wicked are an abomination to the LORD: but the words of the pure are pleasant words.
verses.pt: Os pensamentos do mau são abomináveis ao SENHOR, mas ele se agrada das palavras dos puros.
verses.en_web: Yahweh detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.
verses.en_bbe: Evil designs are disgusting to the Lord, but the words of the clean-hearted are pleasing.

verses.en: He that is greedy of gain troubleth his own house; but he that hateth gifts shall live.
verses.pt: Quem pratica a ganância perturba sua própria casa; mas quem odeia subornos viverá.
verses.en_web: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.
verses.en_bbe: He whose desires are fixed on profit is a cause of trouble to his family; but he who has no desire for offerings will have life.

verses.en: The heart of the righteous studieth to answer: but the mouth of the wicked poureth out evil things.
verses.pt: O coração do justo pensa bem naquilo que vai responder, mas a boca dos perversos derrama maldades em abundância.
verses.en_web: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.
verses.en_bbe: The heart of the upright gives thought to his answer; but from the mouth of the evil-doer comes a stream of evil things.

verses.en: The LORD is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous.
verses.pt: Longe está o SENHOR dos perversos, mas ele escuta a oração dos justos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is far from sinners, but his ear is open to the prayer of the upright.

verses.en: The light of the eyes rejoiceth the heart: and a good report maketh the bones fat.
verses.pt: A luz dos olhos alegra o coração; a boa notícia fortalece os ossos.
verses.en_web: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.
verses.en_bbe: The light of the eyes is a joy to the heart, and good news makes the bones fat.

verses.en: The ear that heareth the reproof of life abideth among the wise.
verses.pt: Os ouvidos que escutam a repreensão da vida habitarão entre os sábios.
verses.en_web: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.
verses.en_bbe: The man whose ear is open to the teaching of life will have his place among the wise.

verses.en: He that refuseth instruction despiseth his own soul: but he that heareth reproof getteth understanding.
verses.pt: Quem rejeita correção menospreza sua própria alma; mas aquele que escuta a repreensão adquire entendimento.
verses.en_web: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.
verses.en_bbe: He who will not be controlled by training has no respect for his soul, but he who gives ear to teaching will get wisdom.

verses.en: The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.
verses.pt: O temor ao SENHOR corrige sabiamente; e antes da honra vem a humildade.
verses.en_web: The fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.
verses.en_bbe: The fear of the Lord is the teaching of wisdom; and a low opinion of oneself goes before honour.
